selection_rule: Select a graphic by the evidence task for each story beat. Tactical diagrams are one option, never the default for every beat.

layouts.purpose: Explain a shape, run, press, or available space.
layouts.sourcing: The authored illustrative pitch is labeled as a diagram; match footage remains a separate approved asset.

layouts.purpose: Compare a small number of sourced team or player metrics.
Show where a claim or dataset came from and when it was published.
Compare numeric values with a paired, labeled horizontal bar display.
Show sourced values changing across ordered match moments or dates.

data_integrity: Only render values supplied by reviewed evidence.
Missing source or values means omit the numeric visualization and use a source-needed editorial card.
Show value labels and source attribution; color alone never encodes meaning.
No radar chart unless normalized comparable data and its benchmark are explicitly provided.
previews: Renderer-exported PNGs for statline, comparison chart and source layouts are provided in previews/; numeric content is illustrative only.
